Lord '''Gann''' is a [[Hunter of the Horn]]. 

== Activities ==
He was part of a group that ambushed [[Gaul]] and [[Sarien]] near [[Remen]]. Gual was captured and put in a gibbet, and Sarien was killed. Gann was injured during the fight and is bed-ridden when [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Perrin Aybara]] come through the town on their way to [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|33}}
